create.name: Adam Dacey
create.bio:
Adam Dacey is a Birmingham meditation teacher who first met Buddhist practice in the Himalayas in the mid-1990s. He spent years in study and retreat in the Tibetan tradition that follows Je Tsongkhapa and lived for a time as a monk before returning to lay life. In 2008 he set up Mindspace, a not-for-profit social enterprise run from Birmingham, to offer meditation in plain, modern language to anyone who wants it.

Most of his work happens across the West Midlands: eight-week evening courses in Harborne, Sutton Coldfield, Solihull and Tettenhall, also streamed live, and day or half-day retreats in Kings Heath, Warwick, the Malvern Hills and Cannock Chase. He also leads silent days in London, weekends in the Lake District and longer retreats in Thailand and Nepal, and has taken the practice into schools, workplaces and prisons. Sessions mix guided meditation, short talks and paired discussion, with themes such as loving-kindness, gratitude, letting go and compassion, sometimes drawing on Buddhist mantra and visualisation. He has written five short practice books, including Guide to the Mindful Way of Life and Find Your Zen, and shares talks and guided practices on his Online Meditation YouTube channel and on Insight Timer.

courses.title: Modern Meditation: An Eight-Week Course for Busy People
courses.description: A weekly evening course that runs each term in Tettenhall, Sutton Coldfield, Harborne and Solihull, or by livestream. Each week pairs a guided meditation with a short talk and a discussion in pairs, on themes such as focus, letting go and quietening the mind for rest. Seating is on chairs and no experience is needed.

courses.title: Retreat to Nepal: Limitless Mind
courses.description: A six-day residential meditation retreat at a hill-station hotel in Nagarkot, looking out over the Himalayas. Guided sittings, teachings and discussion explore the openness and clarity of the mind, with free afternoons for walks and visits to nearby sacred sites.

courses.title: Retreat to Thailand: Little Acts, Great Love, Quiet Joy
courses.description: A six-day residential retreat on the island of Koh Chang, now in its fifth year. The sessions look at bringing calm attention and kindness to ordinary daily activities, with time between sittings to rest or visit the local temple and coast.

courses.title: Buddha Smile: Cultivating Wisdom & Compassion
courses.description: A run of live online sessions on Zoom each Saturday morning through the festive season, closing with a New Year's Eve retreat. It combines guided meditation, visualisation and the Buddha's mantra, and recordings and resources are sent afterwards.

courses.title: Awakening Compassion
courses.description: A six-week self-paced Mindspace+ course in video and audio on developing compassion, from first steps through mantra and visualisation of the Buddha of Compassion to carrying it into daily life. It can be started at any time.

courses.title: Guide to the Mindful Way of Life (e-book)
courses.description: His first book, sold as an instant download. Eight chapters, one for each week of his introductory course, set out simple secular practices for beginners drawn from the older Buddhist meditation tradition.

courses.title: Guide to the Grateful Way of Life (e-book)
courses.description: A self-guided gratitude programme as a download, with a different short practice for each day over eight weeks. Chapters cover gratitude in breathing, eating, relationships, hard times and plans for the future.

courses.title: Find Your Zen (e-book)
courses.description: A short e-book on building a sitting practice with an open and kind attitude, paying attention to posture and the flow of the mind, and carrying that presence into everyday activity.

free_resources.title: Meditation on Gratitude
free_resources.description: An eight-minute guided practice on Insight Timer that turns attention to the people and things we can be thankful for. Free to play.

free_resources.title: Goodwill Breathing
free_resources.description: An eleven-minute guided breathing meditation that links each breath with wishing others well. Free on Insight Timer.

free_resources.title: Get Started with Mindful Meditation
free_resources.description: A free introductory set of short sessions on his site, covering mindful listening, body, breathing, movement, eating, sleep and the heart, taken from the full Mindspace course.
